accepted.text: Revenue rose every year across the four fiscal years shown, reaching its highest in FY2026.
Operating income rose every year across the four fiscal years shown, reaching its highest in FY2026.
Free cash flow rose from FY2024 to FY2025 to FY2026, which is highest in FY2026 (FY2023 free cash flow is unavailable).
Gross margin rose from FY2023 to a peak in FY2025 for the four years, then fell in FY2026, ending below FY2024.
Operating margin dipped in FY2026 from the FY2025 peak, though it stayed well above FY2024 and FY2023.
Net margin in FY2026 was 55.60%, just under 55.85% in FY2025 and above 48.85% in FY2024 and 16.19% in FY2023.
FY2026 operating cash flow was $102.7B against capex of $6.0B, leaving free cash flow of $96.7B.
FY2026 net income was $120.1B on revenue of $215.9B.
Even so, profit growth no longer comes with margin expansion, since gross and operating margins slipped from their peak.
